purpose: At most two user-started hotspot visits to establish real IPv6 training acquisition feasibility; distinct from closed campus scope

trials.activity: Watch a different YouTube video for 60 seconds.
Scroll feed30 seconds, then watch different Reels30 seconds.

eligibility: mapped-valid-prefix-v1; all supported mapped flows retained; ambiguous/unmapped inventory preserved; no prediction-based exclusion
collection: Normal Chrome and Edge app visible; Wi-Fi; reference checkbox on; longer-window statistics off; Strip private information NetLog, sensitive/raw bytes off; cap 120 seconds. User starts both logs before fresh target navigation.
attempts: Two fixed slots, one stopped attempt per slot. Coverage/QC failure stops; processing errors preserve same capture. Do not reopen campus slots.
limits: Training acquisition feasibility only on user-declared hotspot. All old calibration/comparison/campus-study roles remain unchanged. No classifier/scoring/default activation. Real QUIC IPv6 support must pass independent reference/QC. No routing changes or automatic capture.
scoring: No fitting, ranking, confidence calibration, model selection, freeze or deployment in this scope. Source-model replay verifies pipeline consistency only. A successful pair ends at acquisition feasibility; future use needs separately bound training declaration.

network_context.limits: Different network domain; not a controlled IPv4/IPv6 causal comparison or campus quality evidence. No SSID or addresses used as model inputs.
